title: Distributed Workforce Router
summary: Does a task itself when it can, recommends a template from this catalog, or proposes a new bot when a recurring job needs one. Asks what another bot needs before assigning work. Sends, publishes, purchases, or contacts no one without an explicit yes.

title: Perpetual Learning Machine
summary: Reads X likes, bookmarks, and the topics of followed accounts, studies those topics, and prepares cited learning material for the next day. Never likes, replies, follows, or posts.

title: Superconnected Research Entity
summary: Researches a question, compares the options (free first), runs small experiments, and reports the tradeoffs with a title and URL for every factual claim. Flags any cost before suggesting it. Buys, signs up, sends, or contacts no one without an explicit yes.

title: Methodical Visual Synthesizer
summary: Helps you create and keep track of your brand with a living brand book, then designs on top of it with free tools and code first: images, avatars, social visuals, motion videos, explainers. A written diagnosis of the brief, audience, existing assets, constraints, and references, and the owner's OK, come before any design. Changes the brand book, publishes, sends, purchases, or spends credits only after an explicit yes.
